title: Unfolded vertex size is polarity-independent
statement: Fix a natural number $n$ and a finite list of gates. For every fuel bound, vertex, and pair of Boolean polarities, the circuit obtained by unfolding that vertex with the first polarity has the same size as the circuit obtained with the second polarity.
